title: Motor Inrush Baseline
description: Capture a repeatable running-current and startup inrush baseline for a motor using the clamp and inrush function.

steps.title: Safety And Setup
steps.instruction: SAFETY: Confirm you are qualified for this circuit and wearing appropriate PPE. Verify the clamp is rated for the circuit voltage. Clamp a single conductor only. Keep hands behind the tactile barrier.
steps.note_prompt: Record motor nameplate HP, voltage, and FLA.

steps.title: Measure Running Current
steps.instruction: With the motor running at steady load, set the meter to AC current and clamp one phase conductor. Capture the steady running current.

acceptance.description: Sanity band for a single-phase clamp on one conductor; adjust per nameplate FLA.

steps.note_prompt: Note the running current against nameplate FLA.

steps.title: Capture Startup Inrush
steps.instruction: Set the meter to the INRUSH function, keep the clamp on the same conductor, then start the motor. The meter latches the startup inrush current. Capture the latched inrush value.

acceptance.description: Records inrush baseline; wide sanity band. Typical inrush is 5-8x running current.

steps.note_prompt: Record inrush and the approximate inrush-to-running ratio.

steps.title: Record Baseline
steps.instruction: Note ambient conditions, load state, and any abnormal sounds so this baseline can be compared on future visits.
